title: Notice an operator question outcome
when: A worker question is answered, withdrawn or consumed
need: The shared hook and watcher digest prints the saved outcome once. Question status changes wake steering on the next watcher poll and request a report before its scheduled interval. Failed answer delivery stays visible for manual relay. Steering skips questions from hand-started sessions that never held a steering claim; the Inbox and decision-requests list still show them.
review: Source regression coverage; post-release Inbox answer and steering wake proof is still owed.
